text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —Alright, looking good.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
This should make up for my blunder in the 
exhibition race.
choice_data_list: Were you really that worried about it?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Naturally. Believe it or not, I'm quite 
the sore loser.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I wish to show an attitude of calm 
composure in any situation. That is why I 
haven't shown this to anyone until now.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Right now... well, if it's just showing 
you, that should be fine, right?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer-kun. Which race should 
the revived "Emperor" challenge next?
choice_data_list: I want to head for the "Japan Cup".

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
A sound choice. It's on par with the Eight 
Major Races, and is designated as an 
international invitational race.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That championship trophy would suit the 
crown of the "Emperor" quite well.

And so, the next target race was decided: 
the Japan Cup!
—On the way back.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun, did you know? Apparently 
there's a delicious teahouse just ahead.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The student council kids recommended it, 
saying, 'If you're going to Kyoto, you 
absolutely must visit.' What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, did my message not get across? I was 
inviting you to take a detour with me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Heh, is it really that surprising?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...I see. It's true that until now, I 
would work regardless of whether a race 
had just ended.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I still have a mountain of work 
as usual, but I'm giving myself a little 
breathing room right now.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
In other words, I've altered the process. 
While I retain final decision-making 
authority, I have separated myself from 
the day-to-day work to an extent.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Well, basically we're just adding more 
people in charge so we can all tackle this 
together.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...Up until now, for better or worse, I 
was too eager to handle everything on my 
own."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"From now on, however, I will have each 
officer work in their own way to realize 
our ideals."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
More thought and effort will be required 
than ever before. Supporting them will 
keep me busy for a while.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Yet, I cannot build a happy world all by 
myself. Because every single person is 
what makes up this world."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Which means... I'm gonna need everyone to 
give it their all.

Symboli Rudolf doesn't seem strained right 
now. By relying on everyone, it looks like 
she was able to take some weight off her 
shoulders.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Come now, Trainer-kun. First and foremost, 
tea. We must have tea.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Let's grab a quick cup of tea. ...What do 
you say?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...I have felt this for some time now, 
but isn't your evaluation of them a bit 
too harsh?"

Afterward, the two of us stopped by a 
teahouse, and instead of making it 
quick... we had a nice, leisurely chat.
